title: Local criterion step for reverse polynomial chart flatness
statement: For the polynomial chart data of lem-sbc-polynomial-chart-stalk-flat-comparison-reverse, if the base stalk map is flat and the canonical polynomial fibre stalk map is flat, then the chart stalk map is flat.

source.place: Tags 00R7 and 00RH, local criterion for flatness

proof.text: Apply the local criterion for flatness to the stalk tower, using finite presentation, base flatness, and the canonical fibre-stalk identification.

lean.statement:
theorem polynomial_chart_stalk_flat_comparison_reverse_aux
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] (f : X ⟶ T)
    [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (U : X.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] (n : ℕ)
    (e : U.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation e]
    (he : e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T ↘ T) = U.ι ≫ f)
    (x : U.toScheme)
    (hbase : (f.stalkMap (U.ι x)).hom.Flat)
    (hfibre : (PolynomialChart.stalkMap f U n e he x).Flat) :
    (e.stalkMap x).hom.Flat
